description.zh: 要查询的主机地址，可使用域名或IP地址。不支持模糊查询，只支持精确查询。
description.en: The address of the host that you want to query. You can set this parameter to a domain name or an IP address. Only exact match is supported.

description.zh:
要查询的主机所在主机组的ID。
> 您可以调用[ListHostGroups](~~201307~~)接口获取主机组ID。
description.en:
The ID of the host group to which the host to be queried belongs.

> You can call the [ListHostGroups](~~201307~~) operation to query the ID of the host group.

description.zh: 要查询的主机名称。不支持模糊查询，只支持精确查询。
description.en: The name of the host that you want to query. Only exact match is supported.

description.zh:
要查询主机的堡垒机实例ID。
> 您可以调用[DescribeInstances](~~153281~~)接口获取该参数。
description.en:
The ID of the bastion host on which you want to query hosts.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query the ID of the bastion host.

description.zh:
要查询的主机的操作系统。取值：
- **Linux**
- **Windows**
description.en:
The operating system of the host that you want to query. Valid values:

- **Linux**

- **Windows**

description.zh: 设置从返回结果的第几页开始显示查询结果。默认值为**1**，表示从第1页开始显示。
description.en: The number of the page to return. Default value: **1**.

description.zh:
设置分页查询时，每页显示的主机信息的数量。默认值为**10**，表示每页显示10条主机信息。
> 建议PageSize取值不要为空。
description.en:
The number of entries to return on each page. Default value: **10**.

> We recommend that you do not leave this parameter empty.

description.zh:
要查询主机的堡垒机所在地域的ID。
> 地域ID和地域名称的对应关系，请参见[地域和可用区](~~40654~~)。
description.en:
The region ID of the bastion host on which you want to query hosts.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

description.zh:
要查询主机的来源。取值：
- **Local**：本地主机
- **Ecs**：ECS实例
- **Rds**：RDS专属集群主机
description.en:
The source of the host that you want to query. Valid values:

- **Local**: a host in a data center

- **Ecs**: an Elastic Compute Service (ECS) instance

- **Rds**: a host in an ApsaraDB MyBase dedicated cluster

description.zh: 要查询的主机对应的ECS实例ID或专属集群主机ID。不支持模糊查询，只支持精确查询。
description.en: The ID of the ECS instance or the host in an ApsaraDB MyBase dedicated cluster that you want to query. Only exact match is supported.

description.zh:
要查询的主机状态。取值：
 - **Normal**：正常
- **Release**：已释放
description.en:
The status of the host that you want to query. Valid values:

- **Normal**: normal

- **Release**: released

title.zh: 查询指定堡垒机实例下的主机列表

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost list-hosts --instance-id bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --os-type Linux --host-name host --host-address 1.1.XX.XX --source Local --source-instance-id i-bp19ienyt0yax7480000 --source-instance-state Normal --host-group-id 1 --region cn-hangzhou
example.legacyCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost ListHosts --region cn-hangzhou --PageSize 20 --HostGroupId 1 --InstanceId 'bastionhost-cn-st220aw0000' --PageNumber 1 --OSType Linux --RegionId 'cn-hangzhou' --HostAddress '1.1.XX.XX' --SourceInstanceId 'i-bp19ienyt0yax7480000' --HostName host --Source Local --SourceInstanceState Normal
